Ruling: Coordination's ruling, StegVerse-org/.github#162 comment 6371352606 (Oct 23 17:57Z): pin after observe (REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN reads the chain back to the sealed genesis and writes the pin with a consumes receipt, admitted under the governed-element rule; no person, cron, polling or dispatch); trigger route option (b), the org's existing path transfer as an InTr ingress to LLM-adapter, owner Lane B, with a receiver that accepts the GENESIS_PIN signal before the pin exists and refuses every other signal while it is null; and no clock conflict with LC-GOV-04 (observed_at is recorded, never a decision input; the pin is the read-back digest, not a prediction). Built and verified at StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431 @1541d465386d395dcd3034351b2db98e73d58b83: the REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN planner (scripts/llm_adapter_repository_ledger_genesis_pin.py) and the pre-pin InTr ingress receiver (scripts/llm_adapter_genesis_pin_ingress.py); suite 26 ran, OK, 0 skipped (run contract431-genesis-pin-tests). Probed (run genesis-pin-probe): while the pin is null only REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_OBSERVED is received and every other signal is six-field PRE_PIN_SIGNAL_CLASS_NOT_ACCEPTED; forged carriers are refused; after the pin a replayed or real-shaped signal is PRE_PIN_INGRESS_CLOSED and the planner refuses to overwrite (EXPECTED_GENESIS_PIN_CONFLICT); no circularity (the receiver never reaches the pin-gated read, the planner never imports the receiver); the pin written equals the digest read back. #432 @74509feca062d5f17dbefe5730cbb1304ab6b318 names the transition in ORG_LEDGER_GENESIS_NOT_PINNED's next_attempt (run genesis-pin-next-attempt-432). The clock question is closed by the same ruling (no conflict with LC-GOV-04). Remaining: (1) the genesis is not on the published ledger: refs/stegverse/organization-ledger has no repository-ledger/StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter namespace (run org-ledger-llmad-namespace), so the contract pin stays null and #432 stays six-field ORG_LEDGER_GENESIS_NOT_PINNED; (2) the receiver authenticates the ledger copy it is handed only for internal consistency (self-hash seals, chain shape, carrier linkage), not as StegVerse-org/.github's published ref: a caller-created copy with the caller's own genesis and self-sealed InTr pair is ACCEPTED_FOR_GENESIS_PIN and plans a pin to the caller's genesis (row CALLER_WRITTEN_GENESIS_AND_CARRIER_ON_A_CALLER_LEDGER_COPY). The plan writes nothing, so this is safe only if the admitted transition reads the published ref itself; #431 declares the receiver (wiring DECLARED_INTR_DESTINATION_RECEIVER) but no run that binds --org-ledger to the published ref is observable. Delivery of the trigger is LC-KV-20
